extra_vocab.en: to say that you have received something
extra_vocab.note: 常見於電子郵件、訂單與客服通知，請對方或自己正式回報「已收到」。語氣客氣、偏正式，和這篇通知中的 confirm your attendance 同屬「請回覆確認」的用法。
extra_vocab.pattern: confirm receipt of + 收到的東西（N）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: receipt 後面一定要接 of，of 後面接收到的東西（名詞），不接子句；若要接子句，改用 confirm that you received ...。

examples.en: Please confirm receipt of this e-mail by replying to me.
examples.zh: 請回覆我以確認收到這封電子郵件。

examples.en: We will confirm receipt of your order within two days.
examples.zh: 我們會在兩天內確認收到您的訂單。

examples.en: Customers will get a message to confirm receipt of their payment.
examples.zh: 客戶會收到一則訊息，確認已收到他們的付款。

examples.en: Could you confirm receipt of the meeting notes I sent?
examples.zh: 可以請你確認收到我寄的會議紀錄嗎？

similar.diff: 語氣更正式，常用在公司寫給客戶的信；confirm 比較日常、直接。

example.en: We acknowledge receipt of your application and will reply soon.
example.zh: 我們確認收到您的申請，將盡快回覆。

similar.diff: 口語、隨意，適合同事之間；後面接子句（you got it），不是名詞。

example.en: Please let me know you got the file I sent.
example.zh: 請讓我知道你有收到我寄的檔案。

confusable.diff: receive 是動詞「收到」；receipt 是名詞「收到、收據」，兩者同字根。
confusable.usage: receipt 是名詞，所以說 confirm receipt of + N；receive 是動詞，要說 confirm that you received ...。

example.en: Please confirm that you received the package yesterday.
example.zh: 請確認你昨天有收到包裹。

confusable.diff: conform 是「遵守、符合」，和 confirm「確認」只差一個字母，意思完全不同。

example.en: All products must conform to our safety rules.
example.zh: 所有產品都必須符合我們的安全規定。

extra_vocab.zh: 代理人、業務員、旅行社人員
extra_vocab.en: a person who does a job for a company or for another person
extra_vocab.note: 在「The travel agent confirmed my flight to Singapore.」中，travel agent 指旅行社人員，幫客人訂機票與飯店。多益也常見 real estate agent、insurance agent、customer service agent 等職稱。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: agent 是可數名詞，單數前要加 a／the／my 等限定詞（a travel agent）；表示「公司、機構」要用 agency。

example.en: Our sales agents visit about ten clients every week.
example.zh: 我們的業務員每週拜訪大約十位客戶。

example.en: A travel agent helped us book a hotel in Taipei.
example.zh: 旅行社人員幫我們訂了台北的飯店。

example.en: The real estate agent showed us two offices downtown.
example.zh: 房屋仲介帶我們看了市區的兩間辦公室。

example.en: Our insurance agent will visit the office on Tuesday.
example.zh: 我們的保險業務員星期二會來辦公室。

example.en: A customer service agent answered my call within a minute.
example.zh: 客服人員在一分鐘內接起了我的電話。

examples.en: The agent sent me the flight details by e-mail.
examples.zh: 旅行社人員用電子郵件寄給我班機資訊。

examples.en: Please wait while an agent checks your account.
examples.zh: 請稍候，客服人員正在查詢您的帳戶。

examples.en: Each sales agent has a list of regular clients.
examples.zh: 每位業務員都有一份固定客戶名單。

examples.en: We hired an agent to sell our products in Japan.
examples.zh: 我們請了一位代理商在日本銷售我們的產品。

confusable.diff: agenda 是「會議議程」，拼法開頭 agen- 相同，重音位置與意思都不同。

example.en: Please read the meeting agenda before you come.
example.zh: 來之前請先讀會議議程。

similar.diff: representative 是代表公司的人，範圍更廣、更正式；agent 多指替客戶辦事的專業人員。

example.en: A company representative will call you tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 公司代表明天早上會打電話給您。

example.en: The agent met a new client at the airport.
example.zh: 業務員在機場見了一位新客戶。

example.en: Every customer can speak to an agent by phone.
example.zh: 每位顧客都可以用電話與客服人員通話。

example.en: My assistant called the agent to change the booking.
example.zh: 我的助理打電話給旅行社人員更改訂位。

derived.link: agent + -cy，把「代理人」變成「代理機構」，像 emergency 的 -cy 字尾

example.en: The agency sent us a list of hotels in Singapore.
example.zh: 代理公司寄給我們一份新加坡的飯店清單。

senses.en: a person who arranges things for other people as a job

example.en: The agent booked a hotel and a car for our trip.
example.zh: 旅行社人員為我們的旅程訂了飯店和車子。

senses.en: a worker who answers customer calls or messages
senses.distinguish: 常見於 customer service agent、support agent，出現在電話或線上客服情境。

example.en: An agent will be with you in a few minutes.
example.zh: 客服人員幾分鐘後會為您服務。

senses.en: a person who sells or rents houses for the owners
senses.distinguish: 常和 real estate、insurance 連用，指買賣或租賃的專業仲介。

example.en: The agent found a bigger office for our team.
example.zh: 仲介為我們的團隊找到一間更大的辦公室。
